items.title: West Loop meeting set for the 400 N. Morgan development
items.summary: The West Loop Community Organization will host a community meeting on Monday, August 10 at 6 pm about the 400 N. Morgan development. The latest plans add 403 N. items.title: Illinois back-to-school sales tax holiday starts Aug. 7
items.summary: Illinois brings back its 10-day back-to-school sales tax holiday from August 7 to 16, cutting the state sales tax on qualifying clothing and school supplies from 6.25% to 1.25%. Local sales taxes still apply, and the break comes just after Chicago and parts of Cook County saw their combined sales tax rise to 10.5%, among the highest in the nation. Gov. JB Pritzker promoted the break, which lawmakers approved in the spring state budget.

items.title: Chicago pays the nation's highest price to remove lead water lines
items.summary: Chicago pays two to three times what nearby suburbs pay to remove toxic lead water lines, about $33,784 per line compared with $10,950 in Elgin, according to Axios Chicago. At that rate the city faces roughly $13.5 billion to replace its 400,000 lead lines over two decades, a cost that will fall heavily on taxpayers. City officials have not identified concrete plans to lower the charges, even as a federal rule will require removing 20,000 lines a year.
